name: playable-ai-workspace
description: Turn interactive app state into structured AI tasks and human-reviewable candidates.

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter playable-ai build && corepack pnpm --filter @playable-ai/react build && corepack pnpm --filter @playable-ai/server build && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter playable-ai test && corepack pnpm --filter @playable-ai/server test && corepack pnpm --filter @playable-ai/example-local-provider-runtime test
scripts.check: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
scripts.pack:check: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --dir packages/core exec npm pack --dry-run --json && corepack pnpm --dir packages/react exec npm pack --dry-run --json && corepack pnpm --dir packages/server exec npm pack --dry-run --json
